    static double
    H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.calculateAnnualMetabolicNeedGJ(H3Cell cell)
    Calculates the total annual metabolic subsistence energy required by the cell's population in $\text{GJ/year}$: $$E_{\text{metabolic}} = \left(\sum_{c=0}^{6} N_c \cdot e_c\right) \cdot \mu_{\text{PAL}}(K/N, T) \cdot \mu_{\text{species}}$$
    static double
    H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.calculateDynamicAlbedo(H3Cell cell)
    Calculates dynamic surface albedo $\alpha \in [0.06, 0.85]$ based on snow/ice cover, biome, and natural vegetation density: $$\alpha = \alpha_{\text{biome}} \cdot v_{\text{veg}} + 0.30 \cdot (1 - v_{\text{veg}})$$
    static double
    H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.calculateMovementFriction(H3Cell cell, double techLevel)
    Calculates terrain movement friction (cost-distance multiplier) based on elevation, biome, and technology level: $$f_{\text{move}} = \max\left(0.3, f_{\text{base}}(\text{elev}, \text{biome}) \cdot \max(0.2, 1.0 - 0.08 \cdot T)\right)$$
    static BiomassState
    H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.extractBiomassState(H3Cell cell)
    Extracts an immutable BiomassState component from the cell.
    static ClimateState
    H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.extractClimateState(H3Cell cell)
    Extracts an immutable ClimateState component from the cell.

    static double
    H3CellPhysicsAndStateHelper.getEffectiveSurfaceAreaKm2(H3Cell cell)
    Calculates the effective 3D real surface area of the cell in $\text{km}^2$, accounting for embedded H3 resolution and topographical slope expansion: $$A_{3\text{D}} = A_{\text{H3}}(r) \cdot \sqrt{1 + 0.15 \cdot \max(0, f_{\text{move}} - 1)^{1.8}}$$
